WITH award_hand_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(p.bats, '') as batting_hand,
    COUNT(*) as award_count
  FROM player_award pa
  INNER JOIN player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY COALESCE(p.bats, '')
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(award_count) as total_awards,
    COUNT(*) as num_hands
  FROM award_hand_groups
),
hand_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ahg.batting_hand,
    ahg.award_count,
    ahg.award_count::NUMERIC / t.total_awards as share,
    1.0::NUMERIC / t.num_hands as avg_share
  FROM award_hand_groups ahg
  CROSS JOIN totals t
)
SELECT 
  batting_hand,
  award_count,
  share,
  share - avg_share as above_average
FROM hand_stats
WHERE share > avg_share
ORDER BY share DESC
